subject: Re: DevSquad HackBench — credit clearance and onboarding steps
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@hackbench.org>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: HackBench — request for mentor credits & promo extension

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. HackBench is running a three-week hybrid event (Aug 14–Aug 31) with 120 participating teams and ~60 mentors. We're trying to lock down compute and promo support for mentors and maintainers who will be running workshops.

Could Redwood provide:
- 50k free token credits to allocate across mentor accounts (we'll distribute to ~60 emails)
- +2 week trial extension for any mentor accounts that sign up during the event window
- A unique promo code organizers can hand out for maintainers who run workshops

Attached is our sponsorship packet with expected traffic and mentor/maintainer contact windows (hackbench_sponsorship_packet.pdf). If possible we'd like confirmation by the end of next week so we can update the mentor onboarding docs.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the allocation.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Community Partnerships
HackBench

--
Attachment: hackbench_sponsorship_packet.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@hackbench.org>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HackBench — request for mentor credits & promo extension

Hi Samira — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the packet, looks like an awesome event. A couple quick clarifying questions so I can route this internally:

1) How do you want the 50k credits split? (equal per mentor, or reserved pool for maintainers/organizers?)
2) Do mentors need per-user trial extensions tied to email, or do you prefer a single organizer-managed coupon?
3) Any specific SSO/KYC requirements for maintainers we should be aware of (org accounts, GitHub orgs, etc.)?

Tentatively I can propose an initial allocation of 30k credits + a 2-week trial extension for mentor signups, pending internal approval. I'll loop in Ben and Marissa to confirm whether we can stretch to the full 50k and to define promo/code logistics.

If that works, please share: (a) a short list of mentor emails who need immediate access, and (b) your preferred promo/code wording.

Would you be available Fri (Aug 1) 10–11am PT for a quick call to finalize?

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: proposed-credit-plan.xlsx (XLSX, stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HackBench — request for mentor credits & promo extension

Jordan — saw this. I'm comfortable approving an initial 30k credit pool from community engagement budget, and we can extend trial windows to 3 weeks (instead of 2) if Marketing signs off on the public-facing promo code.

Notes / operational items:
- I'll need a short Mutual Action Plan (one-pager) that lists deliverables (mentor list, expected throughput, post-event report) so finance can tag it for the community spend.
- We should create a single organizer-managed promo code (keeps attribution clean) and generate per-email vouchers only for maintainers with special access.
- Suggested promo code format: HACKBENCH-3WEEK (or HACKBENCH-30K if they prefer the credit label).

Jordan — mark me as approver. Marissa, can you sign off on the final wording so I can route it to Finance?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Developer Relations — Grants & Community
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@hackbench.org>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DevSquad HackBench — credit clearance and onboarding steps

Samira / team — thanks for your patience. We reviewed the packet and Ben's recommended approach. Redwood is happy to support HackBench with the following final terms:

- Credit allocation: 30,000 free token credits to be distributed to mentors/organizers as a pooled allotment.
- Trial extension: 3-week trial extension for mentor accounts that sign up during the event period.
- Promo code: organizer-managed promo code HACKBENCH-3WEEK for maintainers running workshops.

Operational asks from HackBench: please provide (1) a short list of mentor/maintainer emails who need immediate access, (2) the finalized organizer contact for promo-code distribution, and (3) a one-page Mutual Action Plan documenting deliverables and a post-event report timeline. Once we have that I will route a formal allocation note to Finance and we can create the promo code.

Jordan — please confirm with Samira and set up the onboarding call (20 min). Samira — Jordan has availability Friday 10–11am PT per his earlier note; can you confirm?

Thanks — delighted to partner on this.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Developer Experience & Community Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--
